title: Compliance officer
description:
**About Us**
 Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
   

  

 At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
   

  

 Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Compliance Officer \& Senior Manager, Client Services – Visa GIFT City
   

  

* Location \- GIFT City, Gujarat, India
* Business Function \- Compliance, Client Services, Regulatory Governance, Client Implementation, Operational Support
* Level \- Senior Manager
* Reports To \- Principal Officer \& Head – Visa GIFT City Branch Dotted\-line reporting to India / Regional Compliance, Risk, Legal, Regulatory Affairs, and Client Services Leadership, as applicable.


**Role Summary**
 The Compliance Officer \& Senior Manager, Client Services – Visa GIFT City will serve a dual mandate: acting as the designated Compliance Officer for Visa’s IFSCA\-licensed GIFT City entity and leading client services delivery for all Visa GIFT City clients.
   

  

 This role is designed for a senior professional who can combine regulatory discipline, operational excellence, client\-facing execution, and cross\-functional leadership. The person will support the Principal Officer in ensuring that Visa’s GIFT City activities are conducted in accordance with applicable IFSCA requirements, internal Visa policies, risk and control standards, and the scope of the entity’s ancillary license.
   

  

 At the same time, the individual will be responsible for ensuring that GIFT City clients — including banks, payment service providers, fintechs, financial institutions, and other eligible entities — receive high\-quality client support across onboarding, implementation, issue resolution, operational readiness, reporting, service reviews, and ongoing relationship servicing.
   

  

 This role will be critical in building a strong control environment while enabling a seamless client experience for Visa’s GIFT City business.
   

  

 What the Compliance Officer \& Senior Manager, Client Services Will Do:
   

  

**Compliance Officer For Visa GIFT City Entity**
* Serve as Visa’s designated Compliance Officer for its IFSCA\-licensed GIFT City entity.
* Support the Principal Officer in maintaining ongoing compliance with applicable IFSCA regulations, circulars, guidelines, license conditions, and internal governance standards.
* Monitor the GIFT City entity’s activities to ensure they remain within the approved scope of Visa’s ancillary license.
* Maintain a compliance calendar covering applicable regulatory filings, submissions, periodic reporting, renewals, certifications, governance reviews, and internal deliverables.
* Coordinate with Legal, Compliance, Risk, Regulatory Affairs, Finance, Tax, Operations, and Client Services teams to ensure regulatory obligations are understood, assigned, tracked, and completed on time.
* Assist in preparing responses to IFSCA information requests, regulatory inspections, supervisory reviews, internal audits, compliance testing, and governance reviews.
* Ensure accurate maintenance of compliance documentation, records, approvals, licenses, policies, SOPs, client records, filings, and audit evidence.
* Track changes in applicable regulations and coordinate with relevant internal stakeholders to assess impact on Visa’s GIFT City activities.
* Support regulatory change management by helping translate legal and regulatory requirements into operational procedures, controls, checklists, and staff awareness materials.
* Escalate actual or potential compliance breaches, regulatory issues, control gaps, conflicts, and operational risks in a timely and structured manner.
* Help build and maintain a culture of compliance, accountability, documentation discipline, and ethical business conduct across the GIFT City office.


**Client Services Leadership For GIFT City Clients**
* Lead client services delivery for all Visa GIFT City clients, including banks, payment service providers, fintechs, financial institutions, and other approved or eligible clients.
* Act as the primary senior client services contact for GIFT City clients, ensuring a consistent, responsive, and high\-quality client experience.
* Own operational readiness, implementation coordination, client onboarding support, issue resolution, service reviews, and ongoing client engagement from a servicing perspective.
* Partner with Sales, Product, Technology, Risk, Legal, Finance, Client Implementation, and regional Client Services teams to deliver Visa solutions efficiently and effectively.
* Help clients understand Visa processes, operating requirements, service models, implementation timelines, documentation needs, support channels, and escalation protocols.
* Manage complex client service issues, ensuring timely triage, internal ownership, root\-cause analysis, escalation, resolution, and client communication.
* Monitor service performance, client satisfaction, open issues, implementation milestones, operational risks, and service\-level trends.
* Conduct periodic client service reviews to discuss operational performance, upcoming initiatives, pain points, risk items, product adoption, and improvement opportunities.
* Serve as the consolidated voice of GIFT City clients for service experience, operational feedback, product usability, process friction, reporting needs, and implementation challenges.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to simplify client onboarding, reduce service issues, enhance operational transparency, and improve client satisfaction.


**Regulatory, Risk \& Control Ownership**
* Support strong risk and control discipline across Visa’s GIFT City operations.
* Ensure Client Services activities are aligned with applicable compliance requirements, internal controls, policies, and risk standards.
* Coordinate with Risk and Compliance stakeholders to provide accurate, timely, and consolidated business inputs across clients, consistent with the governance discipline described in the source JD.
* Own documentation standards, audit readiness, and governance discipline for Compliance and Client Services outputs, consistent with the source JD’s emphasis on documentation, audit readiness, and control ownership.
* Maintain structured evidence for client onboarding, implementation approvals, client communications, issue escalations, service reviews, and regulatory\-relevant activities.
* Identify potential operational, compliance, client, reputational, or regulatory risks and coordinate appropriate remediation plans.
* Help establish and maintain standard operating procedures, checklists, controls, and review mechanisms for GIFT City client servicing.
* Participate in internal risk assessments, control reviews, audits, compliance monitoring, and remediation activities.
* Ensure client\-related issues with regulatory or compliance implications are escalated promptly to the Principal Officer \& and appropriate internal teams.


**Client Onboarding, Implementation \& Operational Readiness**
* Coordinate onboarding of new GIFT City clients onto Visa products, services, platforms, and operating processes.
* Ensure client implementation plans are clearly documented, agreed, tracked, and governed.
* Partner with Implementation, Product, Technology, Risk, Legal, Finance, and Sales teams to support timely launch of client programs.
* Help manage dependencies related to contracts, technical setup, testing, certifications, documentation, billing setup, operational procedures, and go\-live readiness.
* Ensure clients are appropriately educated on operational responsibilities, compliance requirements, processing flows, reporting processes, and service channels.
* Track implementation risks, blockers, delays, dependencies, and escalations.
* Provide regular updates to the Principal Officer, Sales leads, Client Services leadership, and other stakeholders on client implementation status.
* Support post\-launch stabilization, early\-life support, issue triage, and transition to business\-as\-usual servicing.


**Issue Management, Escalations \& Service Excellence**
* Own the end\-to\-end coordination of client service issues for GIFT City clients.
* Establish clear escalation pathways for operational, technical, product, billing, compliance, and implementation issues.
* Ensure each issue has clear ownership, severity classification, resolution timeline, client communication plan, and closure evidence.
* Partner with regional and global Visa support teams to resolve complex client issues.
* Track recurring issues and drive root\-cause analysis to prevent repeat incidents.
* Provide timely and professional client communications during high\-impact issues.
* Create dashboards or structured reporting on open issues, aging, service themes, resolution performance, and improvement actions.
* Drive service excellence by improving responsiveness, transparency, accountability, and follow\-through.
* Support the development of service playbooks, FAQs, process maps, and internal knowledge repositories for GIFT City servicing.


**Business Operations, Reporting \& Governance**
* Build and maintain operational dashboards for GIFT City client services, compliance actions, regulatory deliverables, implementation milestones, and issue management.
* Deliver timely, accurate, and actionable updates to the Principal Officer and senior stakeholders.
* Translate client service data, compliance status, and operational trends into clear recommendations and management insights.
* Support strategic initiatives related to service model design, operational readiness, client support infrastructure, regulatory reporting, and process improvement.
* Partner with Sales and Finance teams to support accurate client, contract, billing, service, and implementation inputs.
* Contribute to governance forums including branch operating reviews, client review meetings, compliance reviews, risk/control reviews, and management updates.
* Maintain clear minutes, action logs, decisions, approvals, and evidence for governance meetings.
* Drive consistent use of internal tools for issue tracking, client documentation, implementation tracking, CRM updates, reporting, and operational workflows.


**Sales, Product \& Cross\-Functional Partnership**
* Partner closely with the Principal Officer and Sales teams to support client growth through strong service delivery and operational execution.
* Provide client services input during deal planning, solution design, implementation planning, contract discussions, and client readiness assessments.
* Help identify operational dependencies, client requirements, product limitations, service risks, and implementation complexity early in the sales cycle.
* Work with Product and Solutions teams to provide structured feedback from GIFT City clients on Visa products, implementation requirements, service needs, and market expectations.
* Build strong partnerships across Sales, Finance, Product, Strategy, Risk, Legal, HR, and Client Services, consistent with the source JD’s stakeholder management expectations.
* Support client workshops, onboarding sessions, implementation reviews, service reviews, and operating model discussions.
* Ensure that service commitments are realistic, documented, aligned with Visa capabilities, and operationally executable.


**Key Measures Of Success**
* Regulatory compliance \- Timely filings, no material compliance breaches, strong audit outcomes, complete regulatory records
* License governance \- Activities remain within approved license scope, timely escalation of material changes or issues
* Client satisfaction \- Improved client feedback, successful service reviews, reduced complaints, strong relationship health
* Implementation delivery \- On\-time client onboarding, reduced launch delays, clear issue tracking, smooth go\-live support
* Issue resolution \- Faster resolution times, reduced aged issues, effective escalation management, lower repeat incidents
* Control discipline \- Strong documentation, audit\-ready records, effective SOPs, clear governance evidence
* Operational excellence \- Reduced manual interventions, improved process consistency, better dashboards and reporting
* Stakeholder confidence \- Positive feedback from Principal Officer, Sales, Compliance, Risk, Legal, Product, and Client Services teams


 Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Basic Qualifications:
   

  

* 8–12\+ years of experience in compliance, client services, client implementation, operations, risk, payments, banking, fintech, financial services, or a related regulated environment.
* Experience supporting financial institutions, banks, payment service providers, fintechs, enterprise clients, or regulated entities.
* Strong understanding of compliance, governance, documentation standards, operational controls, issue management, and audit readiness.
* Demonstrated ability to manage client\-facing service responsibilities while maintaining strong regulatory and control discipline.
* Experience coordinating cross\-functional work across Sales, Product, Risk, Legal, Compliance, Finance, Technology, Operations, and Client Services.
* Strong project management and implementation coordination skills, including action tracking, dependency management, escalation management, and executive reporting.
* Strong analytical capability and comfort using dashboards, reporting tools, CRM systems, service management tools, and Microsoft Office applications.
* Proven ability to translate complex operational or regulatory requirements into practical processes, checklists, SOPs, and client guidance.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with ability to engage senior internal and external stakeholders.
* High integrity, professionalism, sound judgment, attention to detail, and ability to remain effective under pressure.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Prior experience in payments, card networks, digital payments, cross\-border payments, acquiring, issuing, processing, fintech platforms, or payment infrastructure.
* Familiarity with GIFT City, IFSCA, IFSC\-regulated entities, ancillary services, financial services regulation, or offshore financial center operations.
* Experience acting as or supporting a Compliance Officer, Nodal Officer, MLRO, branch compliance lead, risk/control lead, or regulated entity governance role.
* Experience with client onboarding, certification, implementation, technical support, service reviews, and operational readiness for financial services products.
* Experience in regulatory reporting, compliance monitoring, internal audits, control testing, governance forums, and policy implementation.
* Ability to manage ambiguity in a growing business environment and build processes from the ground up.
* Strong stakeholder network or working familiarity with banks, PSPs, fintechs, and financial institutions operating in or around GIFT City.
* Bachelor’s degree in business, finance, commerce, law, economics, engineering, technology, or a related discipline.
* Professional certifications in compliance, risk, payments, project management, audit, or financial services operations would be advantageous.


**Leadership Capabilities**
 The ideal candidate will demonstrate:
   

  

* Compliance mindset — ability to interpret obligations, track deliverables, maintain evidence, and escalate issues appropriately.
* Client centricity — commitment to delivering a high\-quality service experience for GIFT City clients.
* Operational rigor — strong command of process, documentation, governance, controls, dashboards, and follow\-through.
* Issue ownership — ability to drive resolution across multiple internal teams and communicate clearly with clients.
* Cross\-functional influence — ability to work effectively across Sales, Product, Legal, Risk, Finance, Technology, and Client Services.
* Judgment and integrity — ability to balance client needs, business objectives, regulatory requirements, and Visa’s reputation.
* Structured execution — ability to manage competing priorities, deadlines, implementations, escalations, and compliance obligations.
* Continuous improvement — willingness to simplify processes, improve controls, and enhance service delivery over time.


**Candidate Profile**
 This role is best suited for a Senior Manager\-level professional with experience in payments, banking, fintech, client services, compliance, operations, or risk. The candidate should be comfortable operating in a regulated environment while also being highly client\-facing and execution\-oriented.
   

  

 They should be able to support Visa’s GIFT City regulatory obligations, manage client service delivery, coordinate implementation and issue resolution, and build scalable operating processes for a growing business. The ideal candidate will be detail\-oriented, commercially aware, service\-minded, and confident working with senior clients and internal stakeholders.
   

  

**Visa is an EEO Employer**
 Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

title: Regional Environmental Compliance Program Manager
description:
**Overview**
 In alignment with our Microsoft values, we are committed to cultivating an inclusive work environment for all employees to positively impact our culture every day and we need you as a
 **Regional Environmental Compliance Program Manager** 
 for the Asia Pacific (APAC) region.
   

  

 As a
 **Regional Environmental Compliance Program Manager** 
 for the Asia Pacific (APAC) region, you will be managing the full spectrum of regulatory environmental requirements, including Federal, State, and local regulations with emphasis on air, water, waste management and water quality permitting, with a fundamental understanding of environmental management systems. Additionally, you will identify environmental aspects and ensure Microsoft data centers remain in full compliance, communicate these requirements to all stakeholders and senior management, and provide training online and/or in person.
   

  

 This opportunity will allow you to actively participate in a dynamic, challenging, and exciting environment. You will be working independently in\-region and will represent Microsoft to our external and internal customers. You will have a great opportunity to continue learning new tools, work with other Environmental PMs across the globe, third\-party environmental consultants, and as such will grow and develop your career well beyond your established goals. This position requires you to work on location, in one of our data centers in the Asia Pacific (APAC) region, with occasional travel to other locations.
   

  

 Microsoft’s Cloud Operations \& Innovation (CO\+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a
 **Regional Environmental Compliance Program Manager** 
 , you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO\+I is focused on the personal and professional development for all employees and offers trainings and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity \& Inclusion trainings and events, and professional certifications.
   

  

 Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 datacenters in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.
   

  

 With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our datacenter design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever\-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world\-class cloud provider.

title: Legal Service Delivery Specialist, Global Frontline
description:
**Overview**
 Microsoft’s Corporate, External \& Legal Affairs (CELA) organization supports one of the most complex commercial businesses in the world. The Global Frontline team in Customer \& Partner Solutions (CPS) serves as a legal front door for Microsoft Customer and Partner Solutions (MCAPS) and Microsoft Elevate, helping business clients obtain timely, practical legal support and resolving matters at the appropriate level while partnering with attorneys and subject matter experts on higher\-risk or specialized issues.
   

  

 The Legal Service Delivery Specialist is a frontline legal professional operating at the intersection of legal support, service delivery, and workflow improvement. You will serve as a primary legal contact for business clients, resolve complex matters within the team’s scope with minimal supervision, and work across CELA to identify risk, resolve issues, and deliver consistent support across regions.
   

  

 This role offers the opportunity to help define the next generation of legal service delivery within CELA. In addition to supporting individual matters, you will help simplify recurring legal work, strengthen readiness, and develop more scalable ways to support the business. You will work with attorneys, legal professionals, and technology partners to improve workflows and responsibly use data, automation, and AI\-enabled capabilities to increase the speed, quality, and reach of legal support.
   

  

 Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Frontline Legal Support and Client Counseling
   

  

* Serve as a primary legal contact for business clients and complex questions submitted through Global Frontline intake channels. Provide practical legal support with minimal supervision, identify issues and risks, and consult with attorneys or subject matter experts as appropriate.
* Draft, review, negotiate, and process legal and business materials and correspondence. Apply Microsoft policies and approved legal guidance to help clients move work forward while ensuring appropriate escalation and follow\-through.
* Build strong knowledge of Microsoft’s businesses, commercial priorities, CELA processes, and relevant legal frameworks, and apply regional and cultural context to deliver practical, business\-focused support.
* Manage a high volume of matters across multiple clients, priorities, and regions, exercising sound judgment regarding risk, prioritization, escalation, and resource allocation.


 Service Delivery and Readiness
   

  

* Identify recurring client needs, readiness gaps, and process inefficiencies. Work with attorneys and other legal professionals to develop practical guidance, playbooks, intake requirements, training, and self\-service resources that allow the team to take on work deliberately and consistently.
* Use service data and stakeholder feedback to identify trends, assess quality, and recommend improvements to Global Frontline’s scope, processes, and client experience.


 Continuous Improvement and Workflow Innovation
   

  

* Help redesign repeatable legal work for scale and speed. Translate legal and business needs into improved workflows and partner with legal operations, technology, and engineering teams to implement solutions.
* Support responsible adoption of automation and AI\-enabled capabilities in legal workflows, and lead or contribute to projects that help Global Frontline adopt more effective ways of working.


**Qualifications**
 Required Qualifications
   

  

* Bachelor's Degree AND 5\+ years experience in paralegal, legal administration, or relevant experience OR Paralegal Certification that meets the requirements for the location of work AND 6\+ years experience in paralegal, legal administration, or relevant experience OR equivalent experience.

* Experience supporting complex legal or compliance matters with limited supervision and exercising sound judgment regarding risk, prioritization, and escalation.

title: India Tax Lead - Tax, APAC
description:
**About Stripe**
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies \- from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups \- use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Stripe’s mission is to increase the GDP of the internet and we have a staggering amount of work to do. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Our tax team works with Stripes across the company to build an efficient, scalable tax operating model as our international business grows, enters new markets and launches new products. We are looking for an experienced tax leader to own Stripe’s India tax agenda and serve as the principal tax partner for our business and entities in India.
   

  

 This role has a broad remit across all India tax matters — leading direct tax, tax compliance and controls, controversy, planning, policy developments, product and market expansion, and business advisory, and partnering closely with Stripe's global SME teams on India\-specific indirect tax and transfer pricing matters. A central focus will be leading India tax controversy: developing audit and litigation strategy, managing interactions with tax authorities and external advisers, and driving matters to effective resolution. You will work closely with colleagues across Finance, Legal, Treasury, Product, Partnerships, Operations and Policy. The position will be based in Bangalore and report to the APAC Head of Tax.
   

  

 What you will do
   

  

* Own and lead Stripe's end\-to\-end India tax agenda, setting priorities and providing clear, practical advice on all material India tax matters, escalating and aligning with SME teams on positions within their remit.
* Manage India tax controversy, including risk assessment, audit and litigation strategy, responses to information requests and notices, engagement with tax authorities, management of external counsel and advisers, and resolution of disputes.
* Identify emerging India tax risks and opportunities, maintain a clear view of exposures, and communicate recommendations and decisions to senior Tax, Finance and business stakeholders.
* Build and maintain robust India tax controls, documentation and processes, partnering with Accounting and other teams to ensure accurate, timely and audit\-ready compliance.
* Advise on India aspects of new products, commercial arrangements, entity and operating\-model changes, product expansion, intercompany transactions and strategic initiatives.
* Monitor and interpret legislative, regulatory and administrative developments in India, assess their impact on Stripe and lead implementation of required changes.
* Develop strong relationships with internal stakeholders, tax authorities, industry bodies and external advisers, representing Stripe effectively on India tax matters.
* Partner with the APAC and global tax teams on regional and global initiatives, sharing India expertise and ensuring consistency with Stripe’s broader tax strategy.


 We are looking for someone with
   

  

* 12\+ years of relevant India tax experience in a Big 4 firm, law firm and/or multinational organisation, with demonstrated ownership of complex tax matters.
* A professional qualification such as Chartered Accountant, lawyer or equivalent, and deep technical knowledge of Indian corporate and indirect tax law.
* Significant hands\-on experience leading India tax audits, assessments, appeals or litigation, including developing controversy strategy and engaging with tax authorities and advisers.
* Broad working knowledge of Indian direct and indirect taxes, transfer pricing, and withholding tax, with demonstrated ownership of tax compliance, controls, controversy and business advisory for a multinational group, and experience partnering effectively with global SME teams.
* Strong judgement and the ability to translate complex tax issues into clear, pragmatic recommendations for non\-tax stakeholders and senior leaders.
* A track record of working independently, setting priorities and driving cross\-functional matters to resolution in a fast\-moving environment.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the credibility to represent Stripe externally and influence stakeholders at all levels.
* Flexibility to adapt quickly to changes in tax law, administrative practice and Stripe’s business.
* A willingness to work with a diverse set of individuals who care deeply about Stripe’s tax issues and each other.


 It would be nice if you have
   

  

* Experience working in a high\-growth, rapidly scaling environment.
* Experience in technology, payments or financial services.
* Experience with tax policy or industry engagement in India.
* Familiarity with international tax issues.


 ‘Nice to have’ really means ‘nice to have’. It’s completely possible that you don’t have any of these and are still a great fit for the team.
   

  

 To apply please include the following
   

  

* \* LinkedIn profile and resume


 In\-office expectations
   

  

 Office\-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in\-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in\-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.
   

  

 Pay and benefits
   

  

 Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.
   

  

 We look forward to hearing from you.
   

  

 At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.
   

  

 Apply now

title: Legal Research Intern
description:
About Jurisphere
 


 Jurisphere is an AI\-powered legal workspace built for lawyers and legal teams, helping them streamline legal research, document review, drafting, translation, and other document\-heavy workflows. The company recently raised a $2\.2M seed round led by Info Edge Ventures, with participation from Flourish Ventures, Antler and 8i Ventures. Today, Jurisphere is used by 500\+ organisations and 20,000\+ legal professionals, including ICICI Bank, Unilever, Philips, Tata Capital, CMS IndusLaw, and other leading legal teams.
 




  





 About the role
 


 As a Legal Research Intern at Jurisphere, you become part of the team that teaches our AI models how the law actually works and does it rigorously. Your work directly fuels our reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) pipeline: the process by which practicing and student lawyers correct, rank, and refine AI outputs so the model learns to reason like a lawyer.
 




  






 This is your chance to work on the building side of legal AI and shape how the next generation of legal technology is developed, from the ground up.
 




  





**You will:** 



* **Grade AI outputs (RLHF):** 

 Read the model's answers to legal questions and rate them for accuracy, faithfulness to authority, and lawyerly reasoning. Rank competing outputs head\-to\-head. Your ratings become the reinforcement signal that trains the next version of the model.



  




* **Build legal benchmarks:** 

 Help design the tests that measure whether an AI can genuinely reason about Indian law—contract interpretation, statutory construction, precedent application, jurisdictional issues. You'll define what "getting it right" means.



  




* **Write research notes:** 

 Short doctrinal memos on niche areas of law (competition, contracts, IP, IBC, arbitration, tax, etc.) that become reference material for model training. Your synthesis becomes foundational.



  




* **Collaborate with the engineering team:** 

 Your feedback shapes what the model does next. The most valuable interns are the ones who tell us where the model is confidently wrong .



  





  





**You'll fit here if you have:** 



* **Strong legal research and writing skills \-** 

 You can find the authority, read it carefully, and summarize it accurately. You understand the difference between a supporting point and a controlling argument.



  




* **Attention to detail \-** 

 The kind of detail that catches a wrongly\-cited section or a subtle distinguishing fact. The kind that matters in law.



  




* **Comfort with sustained, focused work \-** 

 This is patient, methodical work,closer to law review editing than court hearings and you find it satisfying.



  




* **Genuine intellectual curiosity** 

 about how AI will reshape the legal profession, and the drive to be on the building side of that transformation rather than observing from the sidelines.



  





**Mandatory Requirements** 



* Law Graduate from any reputed college (enrolment not mandatory)
* Being able to commute to Bangalore Office in HSR Layout 5 days a week

 We are a operate as a small, sharp unit so everyone works directly with clients in some capacity.
 



  





**The role** 




 You will work alongside the team across the firm's matters. The work falls into five areas:
 


1. **Drafting.** 
 First drafts of agreements (SaaS, licensing, services, partnership; occasionally other arrangements too), data protection agreements and privacy documentation.
2. **Review.** 
 Reviewing counterparty paper, identifying what matters, and writing up your reasoning in a form a client can act on.
3. **Research.** 
 Legal research on Indian and cross\-border questions, with primary\-source citations and a clear answer.
4. **Proof reading.** 
 You will be required to run the pre\-final read of documentation that is prepared by another lawyer. You are expected to be able to do this with the utmost focus and diligence from the get\-go.
5. **Thought leadership.** 
 Contributing to the firm's thought leadership initiatives; we encourage you to pick a stream that works for you and we do our best to empower you in this.
6. **Discovery initiatives.** 
 Getting under the hood of a new technology, sector or practice area before a client needs us to, and turning what you learn into something the firm can use.



  





**What we are looking for** 



1. Curiosity about how technology actually works, and the patience to read documentation until you understand it.
2. Clear, precise writing. If you cannot explain a clause in plain language, you do not yet understand it.
3. Extreme diligence and organisation. This is a requirement, not a preference. The work depends on nothing being dropped, every loop being closed, and every file being where it should be.
4. Willingness to work with AI tools every day, and the judgment to know when they are wrong.
5. A law degree and enrolment with a State Bar Council (or eligibility to enrol on graduation).
6. Experience is welcome but not required. Fresh graduates and lawyers with a few years of practice are equally welcome.



  





**What we are not looking for** 



1. General corporate or corporate transaction specific practitioners that are looking to continue on that specialised track rather than advance their expertise on working with technology.
2. Someone who wants a narrow specialism from day one, we believe that early years of a practice must be broad by design.
3. Someone who treats review as a checklist. We want to know why a clause matters, not just that it deviates.
4. Someone who finds the technology side of technology law tedious.



  





**How we work** 



1. You will be trained on the firm's operating practice, which ranges from how work is handed off, how reasoning is recorded, and what review you can expect on your drafts.
2. Feedback is considered pivotal to improvement so we encourage direct, but polite and well mannered, communication within the team.
3. You will be in front of clients early, with support. You will need to be able to present yourself accordingly.

title: Associate III - AML KYC Specialist
description:
**Role Description**
**Overview of Role/Principle Responsibilities:**
 To act as subject matter expert on all core AML/KYC due diligence activities, perform robust quality assurance and handle advanced cases, directly supporting the Analysts and providing hands\-on guidance.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Advanced Due Diligence Execution


 Complex Entity Review: Review and perform due diligence on non\-standard, complex structures (e.g., layered ownership, trusts, foundations, offshore vehicles), ensuring full transparency of control and beneficial ownership.
   

  

 Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD): Lead EDD work on high\-risk clients (e.g., PEPs, complex private equity structures, high\-risk geographies):
   

  

 Analyse and corroborate sources of wealth and funds through documentary evidence and public record checks
   

  

 Conduct in\-depth open\-source investigations on high\-risk profiles or negative media hits
   

  

 Liaise with customer agreed escalation point for enhanced approval and/or further escalation
   

  

* Screening and Risk Mitigation


 Name Screening Oversight: Validate name screening s escalated by Analysts, determine false positives and true matches, and make decisions on further escalation.
   

  

 Sanctions/Adverse Media: Investigate and document all genuine matches against sanctions, PEP, and adverse media lists, with clear escalation narratives and recommendations.
   

  

* Risk Assessment \& Rating


 Risk Factor Analysis: Review risk ratings assigned by Analysts, ensure scoring methodologies are correctly applied, and correct or re\-assess where necessary.
   

  

 KYC Reviews: Lead periodic reviews of investor files. Re\-assess documentation based on trigger events—ownership changes, negative news, jurisdiction upgrade/downgrade, etc.
   

  

* Quality Control and Training


 File Review: Execute rigorous file quality checks. Maintain QA checklists, document deficiencies, and confirm corrective action by Analysts.
   

  

 Coaching: Provide hands\-on coaching and process clarification to Analysts and act as the first point of contact for technical queries.
   

  

 Knowledge Sharing: Develop guidance notes, training materials, and best practice documentation for use within the team.
   

  

* Analysis and Implementation


 Procedure Updates: Monitor changes in AML/CFT internal procedures as required. Provide operational input to Team Leaders regarding impacts on workflows.
   

  

 Project Participation: Support remediation, data clean\-up, or regulatory project work as assigned.
   

  

* Casework \& Escalation


 Complex Query Resolution: Act as initial escalation point for complex or unusual cases—either resolve or clearly summarise and escalate to Team Leader/Manager.
   

  

 Investor \& Counterparty Liaison: Handle detailed, technical queries from investors, fund managers, or distributors related to AML/KYC requirements.
   

  

* Know your distribution (KYD) – where applicable
* In\-Depth Questionnaire Analysis: Review DDQ and Wolfsberg Questionnaire responses in detail, cross\-checking answers for plausibility and completeness. Follow up directly with intermediaries if clarifications are needed.
* AML Control Framework Assessment: Conduct a review and summarise the distributor’s or platform’s Financial Crime (FC) control policies and procedures, including initial and ongoing client due diligence processes. Prepare a comparison of intermediaries’ stated practices against client’s risk appetite and regulatory expectations.
* Reliance Assessment Support: Assess whether reliance on the intermediary’s AML controls may be considered, and document the findings. Where Placement Agents are involved, assist in determining if they fulfil a different role and escalate uncertainties to the designated client function.
* Investor Profile Review: Analyse and document who the underlying investors are (retail, HNWI, professional clients, etc.), as disclosed by the distributor or obtained via DDQ.
* Quality Assurance: Review Analysts’ KYD files for thoroughness and escalate deficiencies or high\-risk findings as required.


**Skills And Behaviours Required**
* 5\-6 years’ AML/KYC experience with focus on alternative investments and complex structures
* Demonstrable expertise in risk\-based approaches, screening investigations, and EDD
* Adept communicator, able to articulate complex regulatory topics in practical terms
* Strong attention to detail, time management, and coaching ability
* High proficiency in KYC/AML databases and screening tools Proficiency with office productivity tools; prior exposure to KYC/AML systems advantageous.
* Strong interpersonal skills and team focus


**Skills**
 Anti\-Money Laundering, Attention to Detail, Time Management

title: Manager, External Affairs
description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose\-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.
   

  

**Your work could help protect millions of patients. Here's how.**
 Every medicine that reaches a patient has a story and behind that story is a team of people making sure it's safe. That's where
 **you** 
 come in.
   

  

 We're looking for someone who wants to do more than manage documents. We want someone who understands that every Pharmacovigilance Agreement (PVA) they draft, every Safety Adverse Event Management Plan (SAEMP) they maintain, is a link in a chain that ultimately protects real people.
   

  

**At BMS, your attention to detail isn't just good practice \- it's patient safety in action.**
**So, what will you actually be doing?**
 You'll be working in the Safety Quality Management (SQM) pillar at the heart of our global
 **Patient Safety team** 
 , managing the agreements that govern how we and our external partners handle drug safety information. Think of yourself as a critical connector, bridging BMS, business partners, and CROs to make sure that when safety data matters most, the right processes are in place and running smoothly.
   

  

**Day To Day, That Means**
* Drafting, reviewing, and maintaining PVAs and SAEMPs \- the foundational agreements that keep our pharmacovigilance operations compliant and partner relationships running seamlessly
* Collaborating with global stakeholders across scientific, regulatory, and operational teams \- you won't be siloed; you'll be sought after
* Applying your regulatory knowledge to keep processes sharp, compliant, and continuously improving
* Building genuine relationships with subject matter experts inside and outside Patient Safety \- your network will grow fast here
* Working with industry\-leading platforms like Veeva Vault and SharePoint \- tools that will sharpen your digital toolkit


**What's in it for you?**
 Let's be direct about the
 **real gains** 
 this role offers:
   

  

* Global visibility \- This isn't a local role. You'll interact with colleagues and partners across geographies, giving you an international perspective that's genuinely rare at this level.
* Accelerated expertise \- You'll develop deep knowledge in pharmacovigilance regulations, partner agreement frameworks, and compliance best practices. This is a career\-defining specialism that opens doors across the pharma industry.
* A seat at the table \- You won't just execute tasks; you'll contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and quality projects that shape how Patient Safety operates globally.
* Purposeful work, every day \- The work you do directly supports BMS's mission to discover, develop, and deliver transformative medicines. You'll feel that connection \- it's not abstract here.
* Grow your influence \- You'll regularly engage with technically and culturally diverse colleagues, sharpening your ability to communicate, influence, and lead without authority \- a skill that makes professionals invaluable.
* Broaden your scope – You’ll have opportunities to contribute to additional activities across the SQM organization, expanding your experience and visibility beyond your core responsibilities.


**What You'll Bring**
 You're probably already thinking
 *"that sounds like me"* 
 but just to confirm, here's what we're looking for:
   

  

* A degree in Life Sciences, Nursing, Pharmacy, Regulatory Affairs, or Chemistry (or equivalent experience that tells a similar story)
* A solid understanding of drug development, pharmacovigilance, and regulatory requirements \- you don't need to know everything on day one, but a strong foundation matters
* The kind of organisational skills that mean you actually enjoy juggling priorities, not just surviving them
* A natural communicator who can adapt their style \- whether you're briefing a senior leader or onboarding a new partner, you know how to land a message
* Someone who's people\-first \- you build trust easily and know that great outcomes come from great relationships


 Here, your career isn't just managed. It's
 **championed** 
 .
   

  

*Ready to make your work mean something? We'd love to hear from you.*
**Apply now and become part of a team where every agreement you sign helps keep patients safer.**
 We hire for skills and capabilities, not just credentials – if this role excites you, but doesn’t perfectly match your resume, we encourage you to apply anyway.
   

  

**How We Work**
 Where you work matters – because collaboration, innovation and patient impact happen in many settings. Our roles are structured across four work models: site\-essential, site\-by\-design, field\-based and remote\-by\-design. The model assigned to this role is based on its core responsibilities. Learn more at https://careers.bms.com/ways\-of\-working.
   

  

**Supporting People With Disabilities**
 BMS is dedicated to ensuring that people with disabilities can excel through a transparent recruitment process, reasonable workplace accommodations/adjustments and ongoing support in their roles. Applicants can request a reasonable workplace accommodation/adjustment prior to accepting a job offer. If you require reasonable accommodations/adjustments in completing this application, or in any part of the recruitment process, direct your inquiries to adastaffingsupport@bms.com. Visit careers.bms.com/eeo\-accessibility to access our complete Equal Employment Opportunity statement.
   

  

**Candidate Rights**
 BMS will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, pursuant to applicable laws in your area.
   

  

 For roles based in Los Angeles County only: If you live in or expect to work from Los Angeles County if hired for this position, please visit this page for important additional information: https://careers.bms.com/california\-residents/
   

  

**Data Protection**
 We will never request payments, financial information, or social security numbers during our application or recruitment process. Learn more about protecting yourself at https://careers.bms.com/fraud\-protection.
   

  

 Any data processed in connection with role applications will be treated in accordance with applicable data privacy policies and regulations.
   

  

 If this posting is missing required information required by local law or incorrect, contact BMS at TAEnablement@bms.com with the Job Title and Requisition number. Do not send application\-related inquiries to this email. To check your application status, please login to your Candidate Home Account.

title: Associate Legal Counsel (Legal Manager)
description:
**Purpose of the Role:** 




  





 The purpose of a Legal Manager is to safeguard the company from legal risks, ensure strict compliance with complex food, advertising, and consumer laws, and provide strategic advice for fast\-paced business operations, covering everything from product launches (labelling, IP) to contracts (vendors, distributors) and handling disputes (consumer complaints, litigation). They act as a bridge between the business teams and regulators, translating complex laws into actionable policies to support rapid growth while minimizing legal exposure
 



  





**Qualification \& Experience:** 




  




* Required Education Qualification: LLB and/or LLM
* Required prior Work Experience:
 
 Prior experience in FMCG will be preferred



  





**Knowledge, Skills \& Competencies­:** 




  




* Strong Planning and Execution Skills
* People Skills with Government bodies
* Systems \& Process orientation
* Business Focus



  





  





**Job Responsibilities:** 




  




* Generalist lawyer with the ability to handle the broad spectrum of day\-to\-day legal affairs of the business.
* Strong basis of contractual law and related advising and litigation.
* Drafting, reviewing and negotiating a wide range of commercial contracts, including manufacturing, marketing, supply, copacker and distribution agreements.
* Providing legal advice and \- Identification of key legal risks facing the business and commercial areas (such as contract use and interpretation, food and marketing regulation, privacy, competition and other customer or third\-party claims.
* Developing and coordinating litigation strategies and coordinating centrally all litigation across the country, including engaging and supervising local counsel, and tracking developments and outcomes to minimize exposure.
* Retaining, directing, instructing and supervising external counsel and other professional advisors as required in connection with litigation.
* Proactive partnering with the sales team and be adept in guiding sales in distribution relations, competition related queries, as well as compliances to minimize exposure to commercial and penal risks
* Ensuring compliances to Legal Metrology, Food laws, and IPR laws, rules and regulations including periodical changes announced from time to time to avoid undue litigation along with allied Act/Rules.
* Provide legal support to manufacturing and supply chain operations, including advice on factory laws, labour and industrial relations matters, EHS compliance, contract manufacturing arrangements, product quality and recall issues, regulatory investigations, and business continuity risks
* Experience working closely with factory and manufacturing operations is highly preferred.



  





  





  





**Reporting Relationships:** 




  





**Upwards** 




 Head Legal Foods
 



  





**Downwards** 




 Executive\- Legal
 



  





  





**Growth Path \& Future:** 




  





 Role holder can move upwards depending on performance evaluation.

description:
**About the Company**

 :
 
 Larsen \& Toubro Ltd, commonly known as L\&T, is an Indian multinational conglomerate company, with business interests in engineering, construction, manufacturing, technology, information technology and financial services, headquartered in Mumbai. The company is counted among world's top five construction companies.
 



 The L\&T Group comprises of 93 subsidiaries, 5 associate companies, 27 joint ventures and 35 jointly held operations, operating across basic and heavy engineering, construction, realty, manufacturing of capital goods, information technology, and financial services. This role is based out of Andheri, Mumbai.
 



  





**About the Role**
 : This role involves various responsibilities related to M\&A, investments, contracts, and general corporate advisory.
 



  





  





**Responsibilities**

 :
 




**M\&A and Investments:** 



* Matters pertaining to Scheme of Amalgamation and Arrangement of Companies.
* Matters related to divestment and acquisition of Companies.
* Matters relating to corporate restructuring including Business Transfer Agreements, Asset sale etc.
* Matters relating to Insolvency and Bankruptcy code.
* Compliance with Corporate Governance, SEBI /Stock Exchange requirements.
* Due Diligence assignments.



**Contracts:** 



* Drafting, reviewing and negotiating various types on Contracts, Agreements, tenders, NDAs, Master Service Agreement, Share Purchase Agreement, Joint Venture Agreements, Definitive Agreement, Concession Agreement, Writ Petition, Plaint etc.



**General, Corporate Advisory:** 



* The candidate should be capable of offering opinions on all legal issues, especially Companies Act, SEBI, FEMA, various Labour Laws, Taxation (GST), Environmental Law, Electricity Act, Transfer of Property Act, Stamp Act, Registration Act etc.



  





  





**Qualifications**

 :
 



* Candidates with

* 15\-22 years of post\-qualification experience, preferably with a mix of law firm and in\-house experience.
* In house experience should preferably be with large listed corporate.



  





**Required Skills**

 :
 



* Ability to manage competing priorities, work independently, and influence decision\-making in a fast\-paced, global environment.
* Excellent negotiation, drafting, and stakeholder management skills.
* Proven track record of handling complex commercial transactions.

title: Senior Specialist Legal & Tax
description:
**Summary**
 Actively manages all the statutory accounts functions \& reporting. Responsible for managing basic accounts function efficiently and effectively and support objectives in all regions. Candidate will actively coordinate feasible sales and marketing plans and supports the implementation of these. Support Finance Manager in delivering the goals and objectives set by Head Office and APAC.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

* Legal Affairs


  Draft, review, negotiate and finalize customer agreements, vendor and procurement contracts, service agreements, NDAs, master service agreements, lease agreements, employment contracts and consultancy agreements.
   

  

  Provide legal guidance to management and business functions on contractual obligations, legal exposure, commercial matters and risk mitigation.
   

  

  Support commercial negotiations, strategic transactions and business expansion initiatives.
   

  

  Manage legal notices, disputes, litigation, arbitration and mediation matters, including coordination with external legal counsel and regulatory authorities.
   

  

  Monitor ongoing legal cases and provide timely status and risk reports to management.
   

  

  Ensure compliance with the Companies Act, 2013, FEMA, RBI requirements, commercial laws, labour and employment laws, data privacy requirements and other applicable regulations.
   

  

  Maintain the contract and legal\-document repository, including renewal and obligation tracking.
   

  

  Conduct legal risk assessments, recommend mitigation measures, review insurance policies and support claim management.
   

  

* Taxation


 Direct Tax
   

  

  Ensure compliance with the Income\-tax Act and applicable rules.
   

  

  Oversee corporate income\-tax returns, advance\-tax computations and TDS /TCS compliance.
   

  

  Manage transfer\-pricing documentation, audits and related compliance
   

  

  Lead income\-tax assessments, audits, notices and appeals in coordination with external advisers and authorities.
   

  

  Identify tax\-planning opportunities consistent with law and the Company’s risk appetite. Indirect Tax
   

  

  Ensure end\-to\-end GST compliance, including returns, reconciliations, e\-invoicing and e\-way bill requirements.
   

  

  Handle GST assessments, audits, notices, litigation, refund claims and related documentation.
   

  

  Monitor legislative changes, assess their business impact and communicate required actions to relevant stakeholders.
   

  

* FEMA \& Regulatory Compliance


  Ensure FEMA compliance for imports, exports, foreign remittances, cross\-border transactions,ECB matters and applicable RBI reporting.
   

  

  Coordinate with authorized dealer banks, consultants and regulatory authorities.
   

  

  Maintain a regulatory calendar and evidence of timely submissions.
   

  

* Corporate Compliance \& Secretarial Coordination


  Ensure timely statutory and regulatory filings.
   

  

  Support Board and shareholder meetings and coordinate with the Company Secretary on secretarial matters.
   

  

  Maintain statutory records and compliance calendars.
   

  

  Support internal, statutory, tax and regulatory audits, including timely closure of observations.
   

  

 Who You Are
   

  

 Bachelor of Laws (LL.B.).
   

  

 CA Inter / Diploma in Taxation
   

  

 Commercial Awareness
   

  

 5\-6 Years of experience
   

  

 Relevant experience across legal, tax and compliance, preferably in a manufacturing, engineering, industrial or multinational organization.
   

  

 Who We Are
   

  

 At Belimo, we take pride in making our company a rewarding place to work. Our leaders are value\-driven and encourage new ideas in their teams around the world. Through our passion, our employees are not only creating amazing products, they are revolutionizing the HVAC industry. Investing in our people is at the heart of Belimo's approach to engaging diverse creative talent to grow an industry\-leading company. The success of our corporate brand is based on the expertise and commitment of each individual.

title: Associate Securities Lawyer
description:
**Company Description** 
 The Law Point (TLP) is a disputes and regulatory\-focused law firm, founded in 2006, with offices in Mumbai and New Delhi. The firm represents leading private and public companies, regulators, statutory authorities, charities, and high\-net\-worth individuals before a range of judicial and quasi\-judicial forums. TLP’s practice spans commercial litigation and arbitration, regulatory advisory and disputes, white\-collar crime defence, infrastructure contract management, and pre\-dispute advisory work across multiple sectors. The team comprises a structured hierarchy of partners, counsel, and lawyers, combining the energy of a young firm with nearly two decades of experience. TLP offers a professional environment with exposure to complex matters and opportunities for growth in dispute resolution and regulatory work.
 



**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Associate Securities Lawyer role based in Mumbai. The associate will work on matters before SAT, NCLT, High Court, including advising on regulatory compliance.
 



**Qualifications** 







* Strong foundation in securities law, corporate law, and financial markets regulation, with the ability to interpret and apply relevant statutes, rules, and circulars.
* Experience or demonstrated interest in regulatory advisory work, including compliance assessments, liaison with regulators, and handling enforcement or investigative proceedings.
* Skills in legal research, analysis, and drafting, with the ability to prepare clear and precise pleadings, opinions, transaction documents, and internal notes.
* Exposure to dispute resolution, including litigation and arbitration related to securities and commercial matters, and comfort appearing before forums under guidance of senior lawyers.
* Strong communication and client\-handling abilities, including structured written communication, professional client interactions, and effective collaboration with colleagues.
* Ability to manage multiple matters, meet deadlines, and work efficiently in a fast\-paced, on\-site law firm environment.
* Bachelor’s degree in law (LL.B.) from a recognized institution with minimum 3 years of post qualification experince; additional qualifications in securities or corporate law are an advantage.

**Company Description** 
 Bombay Juris Law Offices is a full\-service corporate and commercial law firm operating in a boutique, high\-touch setting. Founded on client\-centricity, excellence, and result\-oriented advocacy, the firm blends decades of legal experience with a pragmatic, solution\-driven approach. It advises both individuals and businesses across complex legal and business challenges while maintaining the highest standards of ethics, integrity, and personalized service. Recognized as a “Top Emerging Legal Advisory Firm India 2025” and for “Excellence in Corporate \& Investments Laws Advisory,” Bombay Juris serves clients in practice areas including general corporate and commercial law, banking and finance, VC/PE, M\&A, funds, startups, technology and data privacy, corporate governance, real estate, white\-collar investigations, international trade, tax, estate planning, and the not\-for\-profit sector. The firm’s mission is to deliver premium legal counsel aligned with each client’s unique goals and to build trusted, long\-term partnerships grounded in sustainable value.

title: Compliance Officer and Company Secretary
description:
**About**
**National Investment and Infrastructure Fund Limited**





  





 National Investment and Infrastructure Fund Limited (“NIIF”) is India’s largest infrastructure and private equity fund manager, with \~ USD 7\.3\+ billion in assets under management. Anchored by the Government of India (GoI), NIIF aims to mobilize capital from international and domestic institutional investors for large scale investments in the country through its six funds. Investors in NIIF funds include: sovereign wealth funds like Abu Dhabi Investment Authority (ADIA) and Temasek; global pension funds like Ontario Teachers’ Pension Plan (OTPP), AustralianSuper, CPP Investments, PSP Investments; development financial institutions like U.S International Development Finance Corporation (USIDFC); multilateral development banks like Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank (AIIB), Asian Development Bank (ADB) and New Development Bank (NDB); and top domestic financial institutions such as State Bank of India, HDFC Group, ICICI Bank, Kotak Life and Axis Bank. 
 



  





**Job Responsibilities :**




  





**Board Advisory, Governance \& Leadership**




 • Serve as a trusted advisor to the Board and senior management on governance, fiduciary obligations and regulatory developments.
 



 • Lead Board and committee processes, including agenda setting, preparation of papers, minutes and resolutions, and tracking of action items.
 



 • Shape and institutionalise governance frameworks across the Manager, Funds, Trustee and portfolio companies.
 



 • Build and lead a high\-performing compliance and secretarial team, with responsibility for capacity, quality and execution standards across the function.
 



  





**Platform Oversight \& Stakeholder Management**




 • Act as the central point of interface with institutional investors, regulators, trustees, auditors, custodians and depositories.
 



 • Drive consistency of governance and compliance standards across a diversified fund platform and portfolio ecosystem.
 



 • Provide strategic support on fund structuring, investor onboarding and key governance aspects of capital raising.
 



  





**Regulatory Strategy \& AIF Compliance**




 • Lead compliance with SEBI (AIF) Regulations, Companies Act, FEMA and other applicable regulatory frameworks.
 



 • Oversee regulatory filings and reporting across SEBI, RBI, MCA/ROC and other authorities.
 



 • Manage fund\-level and investor\-level reporting, including FATCA/CRS, Form 64D, FLA, QAR/QCR and other statutory requirements.
 



 • Engage proactively with regulators and track regulatory developments to ensure timely, forward\-looking implementation.
 



  





**Compliance Frameworks, Risk Oversight \& Controls**




 • Design and embed robust compliance frameworks, internal controls and governance policies across entities and funds.
 



 • Lead regulatory inspections, internal audits and compliance reviews.
 



 • Partner closely with investment, finance and legal teams to enable business objectives within a disciplined risk framework.
 



  





**Fund \& Entity Lifecycle Management**




 • Oversee fund formation, structuring, documentation and regulatory approvals.
 



 • Manage lifecycle events across portfolio entities, including incorporation, restructuring and exits.
 



 • Ensure governance and compliance considerations are embedded across investment lifecycles.
 



 Secretarial \& Corporate Administration 
 



  





**Secretarial \& Corporate Administration**




 • Ensure maintenance of statutory registers, corporate records and governance documentation across entities.
 



 • Oversee filings, disclosures and completion of secretarial audits.
 



 • Draft and review resolutions, governance policies and key corporate documentation.
 



  





**Key Skills**




 • Strong judgement in regulatory and governance matters
 



 • Credibility to engage with Boards, regulators and global institutional investors
 



 • Leadership capability with experience building and managing teams
 



 • High attention to detail with a pragmatic, risk\-based approach
 



 • Commercial acumen and ability to operate in a dynamic investment platform
 



  





**Qualification and Experience**




 • Qualified Company Secretary (ICSI mandatory); LLB or equivalent preferred.
 



 • Experience in AIF / private equity / asset management / financial services.
 



 • Strong working knowledge of SEBI and IFSCA AIF Regulations, corporate law and regulatory frameworks.
 



 • Experience working with large institutional and foreign investors.
 



 • Demonstrated experience managing multi\-entity and SPV structures.

title: Assistant Manager - Compliance Review Controller
description:
**Job Title:** 
 Compliance Review Controller (Assistant Manager)
   

  

**Department** 
 : India Compliance COE
   

  

**About Business line/Function:** 
 CIB
   

  

**India COE Compliance Hub:** 
 The India CoE Compliance Hub serves as a strategic global partner to Compliance functions, helping safeguard the Group’s reputation and manage risk across all business lines. Organized around specialized service domains, the Hub provides expertise in
 **Financial Security (KYC, Sanctions, and Quality Assurance), Operational Risk \& Controls, Conduct, Data Governance, Market Integrity, Operational Efficiency and AI Enablement** 
 , and other
 **transversal Compliance activities** 
 .
   

  

 Working in close partnership with stakeholders across geographies and business lines, the Hub drives operational excellence, enhances risk management capabilities, fosters innovation, and supports the execution of the Group’s global Compliance strategy.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Direct Responsibilities
   

  

 The person will be a part of the Transversal Risk Management (TRM) team reporting to Team Lead, Non\-FS Controls.
   

  

* Perform testing and controls as defined by internal procedures independently or with limited guidance under the supervision of TRM Managers or their delegates in order to assess and review compliance with legal, regulatory and internal firm policy and procedure requirements
* Maintain an audit trail for all work carried out during the control testing, reporting and action plan stages
* Challenge the 1LoD control framework including control applicability, design, methodology (for sampling and rating) as well as other factors to ensure that the compliance risk articulated in the key objectives of the Generic Control library (GCL) or the Central Control Library (CCL) is appropriately mitigated.
* Escalate weaknesses identified to TRM Managers or their delegates for discussion and further investigation if deemed necessary.
* Draft and validate issues and recommendations with 1LoD stakeholders addressing the root cause of the issues with stakeholders.
* Ensure that all findings and recommendations are entered into the appropriate tool for tracking purposes, perform periodic follow\-up with stakeholders of open issues and review/validate submitted closure evidence to ensure proper resolution.
* Ensure that all the results are reported into Digitized Control Sheets, SharePoint Workflow, CIB/TRM SharePoint Reporting tool \& PowerBI dashboards. Ensure to use various tools as rolled out by CIB / TRM\-E team from time to time
* Enhance, deliver, and support the annual TRM Plan, ensuring coverage for existing Firm standards, new regulations, changes to existing regulations, and any audit or exam findings.
* Achieve objectives within strict time constraints.


 Contributing Responsibilities
   

  

* In the spirit of continuous improvement, assist with the identification of potential enhancements to the TRM process, tools, reporting and analytics and provide suggestions on how to improve, add to, or streamline current practices in the firm.
* Mentor junior analysts/associate‑level testers; review their work for quality and compliance.
* Assist the team manager with tasks which may include assisting in testing reviews, preparing materials, organizing meetings, and taking minutes.
* Respond timely to internal or external requests for information and analysis.
* Assist in responding to regulatory and internal audit queries.
* Assist with related Compliance monitoring activities as needed.
* Promote a compliance culture within the firm which supposes also to update knowledge on a regular basis.
* Conduct knowledge‑sharing sessions, workshops and on‑the‑job training
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement and proactive risk awareness

title: Head - Legal India
description:
Are you ready to lead the charge in shaping a sustainable energy future? At Alfa Laval, we don’t just overcome challenges—we pioneer solutions that create a positive impact for our customers, our people, and the planet. Our curiosity sparks innovation, and our commitment drives us to deliver transformative results every single day.


Join a truly diverse and inclusive team where your leadership will make a real difference. At Alfa Laval, you’ll be empowered to build bridges to the future, delivering sustainable solutions that address the world’s most urgent energy challenges. Together, we’re making the world a better place.

**About Alfa Laval**


Alfa Laval is a leading global provider of products and solutions in heat transfer, separation, and fluid handling, serving customers across the energy, food, water, and marine industries. Headquartered in Lund, Sweden, the company operates in more than 100 countries, enabling customers to improve energy efficiency, productivity, and sustainability in industrial processes.


With a heritage of over 140 years, Alfa Laval plays a critical role in supporting the global energy transition, focusing on solutions for energy efficiency, waste heat recovery, decarbonization, and sustainable industrial growth. Sustainability and responsible use of resources are central to the company’s purpose of pioneering positive impact.

**Alfa Laval India**

Alfa Laval has been present in India since 1937 and plays a strategically important role within the group. The India headquarters is located in Pune, with eight manufacturing facilities based at Pune and Satara, and multiple sales and service locations across the country. The Manufacturing facilities supplies key components and systems in Separation, Heat Transfer, and Flow technology. It is also a hub for Centrifugal Separators, Decanters, and Flow equipment delivered to the global markets from here.


The company's products and solutions are omnipresent in over 25 multiple Indian industries including food processing, dairy, edible oil processing, sugar production, pharmaceutical \& biotechnology, brewery, distillery, starch, pulp and paper, oil \& gas, marine and energy. Alfa Laval caters to many national and international clients based across India and neighboring countries like Sri Lanka, Nepal, and Bangladesh.


We are now looking for an inspirational leader to spearhead the **Legal** **function** in India, partnering closely with the business leaders and managers.

**Role Description**


The Head of Legal for Alfa Laval India is responsible for leading the legal and compliance function by developing and executing legal strategies aligned with the organization’s business objectives. This role serves as a trusted advisor to the leadership team, providing proactive, business\-oriented legal counsel across areas such as commercial contracts, regulatory compliance, mergers and acquisitions, intellectual property, and risk management. The position ensures adherence to applicable laws and internal policies, drives robust compliance frameworks across areas like anti\-corruption, trade sanctions, competition law, and data privacy, and oversee dispute resolution and litigation in coordination with external counsel. Additionally, the Head of Legal leads and develops a high\-performing legal team, strengthens governance practices, and fosters a culture of integrity, accountability, and continuous improvement in line with Alfa Laval’s values.

**Key elements of the Role involve**

* Provide comprehensive legal expertise across specialized and generalist areas, including commercial contracts, R\&D, product liability, mergers \& acquisitions, and intellectual property (excluding patents and design), supported by robust commercial, legal, and ethical risk assessments.
* Act as a strategic business partner to management by proactively identifying and advising on legal risks and opportunities to enable informed decision\-making and drive business growth.
* Draft, review, and negotiate a wide range of complex commercial agreements, ensuring alignment with organizational objectives and regulatory requirements.
* Lead and support the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of legal policies, processes, template agreements, and supporting tools.
* Drive compliance management across key areas such as Export Control \& Sanctions, Anti\-Bribery \& Anti\-Corruption, Fair Competition, and Data Privacy, including strengthening governance frameworks and best practices.
* Conduct legal and compliance training for business stakeholders, enhancing awareness in areas such as commercial contracts, corporate governance, and regulatory compliance, while fostering knowledge sharing within the legal and compliance teams.
* Manage and coordinate disputes and litigation matters in collaboration with external counsel, ensuring effective resolution and risk mitigation.
* Monitor and interpret legislative and regulatory developments, advising the business on potential impacts and implementing proactive risk mitigation strategies.
* Oversee Company Secretarial responsibilities for Alfa Laval India Cluster companies, ensuring compliance with statutory and corporate governance requirements.
* Lead and oversee Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) initiatives, ensuring compliance with statutory requirements and alignment with the organization’s sustainability and community engagement goals.

**Strategic Skills \& Leadership Profile**

* Over 10\-15 years of relevant legal experience in in\-house and/or private practice environments with Bachelor’s Degree in Law (LL.B.) or higher
* Qualified Company Secretary (ACS/FCS)
* Proven experience in negotiating complex, high\-value commercial contracts with multinational organizations
* Strong commercial acumen with excellent stakeholder management and collaboration skills
* Expertise in compliance areas including Export Control, Trade Sanctions, Anti\-Bribery \& Anti\-Corruption, Fair Competition, and Data Privacy (preferred)
* Demonstrated experience in training, mentoring, or leading legal professionals

This role reports to the Group Affairs Manager, India
