 We’re proud to have been helping our clients build better financial futures for over 50 years. How have we achieved this? By working together \- and supporting each other \- all over the world. So, join our team and feel like you’re part of something bigger.
   

  

**About Your Team**
 You will be part of the India Legal Team, within the Commercial Legal vertical, front\-ending drafting, review and negotiation of procurement and commercial contracts supporting Fidelity International's internal business units (Technology, HR, CPS, Marketing, Finance, etc.) and sourcing functions across global offices.
   

  

 As part of Fidelity’s General Counsel function (Group Legal and Tax ), you will work closely with our legal, tax, regulatory compliance and commercial counterparts based in the Asia Pacific, United Kingdom, Continental Europe, Canada and other jurisdictions on cross border support covering commercial contracts, business legal document, Company Secretariat and other legal documentation.
   

  

 The team’s focus is on providing agile, pragmatic, business\-aligned legal support while minimizing reliance on external counsel and ensuring minimum legal / regulatory exposure to the organisation.
   

  

**About Your Role**
 This is a fast\-paced role within the Commercial Legal team, requiring high\-quality legal analysis, risk assessment, and cross\-border engagement. You will need a strong sense of commercial understanding, attention to detail, adaptability, and the ability to work at pace with confidence.
   

  

 Key aspects of your role include:
   

  

* Providing front\-end legal support for drafting, reviewing, and negotiating a wide range of procurement and commercial agreements, with particular emphasis on emerging technologies such as cloud services and GenAI.
* Interfacing directly with global stakeholders and advising on legal and compliance issues linked to onboarding third\-party tech solutions or developing in\-house capabilities, including those involving staff augmentation and temporary workforce arrangements
* Supporting cloud regulatory compliance work including review of new cloud/technology deployment requests, Cloud Regulatory Forum coordination, entity mapping and Local Compliance notifications.
* Collaborating with colleagues across functions and geographies to deliver pragmatic, business\-aligned legal solutions.


 Contributing to continuous process improvement, knowledge sharing, and technology adoption within the team.
   

  

 We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of background, and strive to create an environment where everyone can thrive.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Draft, review and negotiate a variety of procurement and commercial contracts, including both technology and non\-technology engagements such as Cloud Outsourcing Agreements, SaaS, IaaS, Software Licences, Master Services Agreements, Statements of Work, Consulting and Facilities Agreements, Change Orders, and Data Processing Agreements.
* Independently manage strategic and complex technology vendor matters, including cloud, enterprise software, AI/GenAI, and data / market data providers, negotiating with major suppliers to secure favourable and risk\-appropriate terms.
* Support business and sourcing teams on onboarding third\-party AI and GenAI solutions or developing these in\-house, including IP, data, ethics, and regulatory considerations.
* Understand and interpret international Tech/Cloud Outsourcing regulations (ESMA, EBA, EIOPA, CSSF, DORA, EU AI Act, GDPR, DPDP Act, operational resilience requirements, etc.) and apply them to contracts.
* Review new cloud and technology deployment requests, coordinate with TRAO and Local Compliance on regulatory notifications and applicability assessments, and support Cloud Regulatory Forum processes.
* Collaborate with procurement to resolve legal and commercial issues and maintain compliance with company policies.
* Provide legal advice on matters related to existing procurement contracts and ongoing supplier service engagements, including amendments, renewals and terminations, balancing legal, regulatory, commercial and business considerations to mitigate risk and enable stakeholders to move forward with clarity and confidence.
* Research and stay current on emerging technology developments (AI, GenAI, blockchain, digital assets and tokenisation, cloud, crypto, open\-source software) and proactively assess their impact on commercial contracts and regulatory compliance.
* Prepare presentations, guidance notes and knowledge materials on emerging tech and related legal / regulatory themes for the team, sourcing and business stakeholders.
* Support legal operations and drive process improvements, including automating legal request intake, establishing knowledge\-sharing platforms, and developing AI/technology contracting playbooks and checklists for suppliers, the legal team and technology stakeholders; support training for sourcing and procurement teams on emerging tech and regulatory topics.
* Pursue relevant professional development including certifications, seminars and external sessions on data privacy, emerging tech regulation and related areas.
* Demonstrate adaptability, collaboration, and a proactive approach in all interactions.


**About You**
 In this role you will be required to have:
   

  

* LLB with 5–6 years of relevant experience, preferably in an in\-house role within a multinational organisation (Financial Services, Asset Management, or Information Technology industries preferred).
* Experience in reviewing and negotiating commercial contracts across both technology and non\-technology engagements, including cloud services (SaaS, IaaS, PaaS), outsourcing, software licensing, market data, consulting, facilities, and profeesional services (staff augmentation, consulting etc.).
* Knowledge of cloud outsourcing regulatory frameworks (e.g., ESMA, EBA, DORA) and their application to technology contracts.
* Ability to assess commercial and legal risk relating to technology and outsourcing regulatory compliance.
* Familiarity with current technology trends such as AI, GenAI, platform integration, data processing, and their legal and regulatory implications.
* General understanding of how technologies work, including APIs, data security / backups, Cloud Escrow, and SaaS/IaaS/PaaS deployments and cloud security.
* Strong oral and written communication skills; excellent judgment; business sense.
* Excellent drafting and negotiation skills.
* Commercial judgement, business acumen, pragmatic and a solutions\-oriented mindset.
* High ethical standards and professional integrity.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple matters in parallel.
* Experience working on cross\-border contracts and international engagements.
* Genuine interest in technology and emerging tech – someone who keeps up with developments in AI, GenAI, cloud, blockchain and data privacy because they want to, not because they have to.
* Experience with contract management systems, e\-signature platforms, and other legal technology tools is desirable.
* Self\-starter, research\-oriented and self\-driven – able to take ownership of new and evolving matters with limited supervision, independently learn about new technologies, understand their contractual and regulatory implications, and translate that into practical guidance for stakeholders as the organisation’s technology priorities change.
* Comfortable presenting complex tech/regulatory topics to non\-legal audiences using presentations, diagrams and practical examples.
* Demonstrated adaptability, collaboration, and a proactive approach.
* Positive, pro\-active attitude suited to be a team member within a dynamic business environment.
* Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build strong relationships with stakeholders.


**Feel rewarded**
 For starters, we’ll offer you a comprehensive benefits package. We’ll value your wellbeing and support your development. And we’ll be as flexible as we can about where and when you work – finding a balance that works for all of us. It’s all part of our commitment to making you feel motivated by the work you do and happy to be part of our team. For more about our work, our approach to dynamic working and how you could build your future here, visit careers.fidelityinternational.com.

* Identify opportunities to strengthen governance, controls and risk management across cross\-border workforce programs.


**Governance \& Risk Management**
* Develop and enhance policies, standard operating procedures (SOPs), governance frameworks and operational guidance to support consistent and scalable Mobility \& Employment Tax processes.
* Drive standardization and documentation of key processes, controls and risk mitigation practices across jurisdictions.
* Partner with stakeholders to strengthen governance, improve controls and ensure audit readiness across Mobility \& Employment Tax programs.


**Global Compensation Review \& Reporting Governance**
* Provide review and oversight of global compensation reporting processes, including equity compensation and stock incentive plans such as RSUs, stock options, ESPPs, deferred compensation arrangements and bonus programs.
* Review employment tax, payroll withholding and reporting implications of compensation and equity programs across multiple jurisdictions.
* Manage stakeholder escalations relating to compensation reporting, stock plan taxation and employee tax reporting requirements.
* Support governance and technical review of year\-end reporting processes, payroll instructions and global compensation reporting obligations.
* Partner with Compensation, Payroll, HR and external advisors to resolve technical issues, strengthen controls and drive reporting consistency globally.


**Knowledge / Qualifications**
* Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA) with 10\+ years of relevant experience in Employment Tax, Global Mobility Tax, Individual Tax or related advisory/compliance functions. Prior experience within a Big Four firm and/or a multinational organization preferred.
* Strong technical knowledge of employment tax, payroll withholding, compensation reporting, social security and individual tax compliance requirements across India and APAC jurisdictions.
* Experience advising on cross\-border workforce matters, including international assignments, business travelers, remote working arrangements and permanent transfers.
* Knowledge of equity compensation plans, including RSUs, stock options, ESPPs and related cross\-border tax implications.
* Proven ability to assess tax risks, interpret complex legislation and provide practical, commercially balanced solutions.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with experience partnering across HR, Payroll, Compensation, Finance, Legal and external advisors.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving and project management skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex tax matters to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced, dynamic global environment and manage competing priorities.


**Competencies Required**
* High level of attention to detail and accuracy.
* Strong technical and risk management mindset.
* Strong Excel, analytical and data interpretation skills.
* Ability to build strong relationships and collaborate effectively across functions, regions, and cultures.
* Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills.
* Proven ability to manage competing priorities and deliver against tight deadlines.
* Adaptable, resilient and embracing of change.
* Ability to identify, analyse and improve processes, driving continuous improvement and operational excellence.
* Discretion and sound judgement in handling confidential information.
* Strong team player with experience working effectively across global and remote teams.


**Our Benefits**
 To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
   

  

**Our hybrid work model**
 BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
   

  

**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
 At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision\-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
 **guidance** 
 on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
   

  

**About BlackRock**
 At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well\-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
   

  

 This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
   

  

 To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.

Headquartered in Cleveland, Ohio, and operating across the globe, we are a trusted partner to our financial institution, FinTech, money service business, and corporate clients.
   

  

 Using a blend of highly trained anti\-financial crime professionals, cutting\-edge technology tools, and industry\-leading consultants, we help clients with their AML/BSA, transaction monitoring, client onboarding (KYC), enhanced due diligence (EDD), and risk management needs.
   

  

 We support clients in meeting day\-to\-day compliance tasks, urgent projects, and strategic changes. Globally, our staff of more than 6,000 highly trained analysts and subject matter experts is the industry's largest group of full\-time compliance professionals. Together with our clients, we are Reimagining Compliance.
   

  

**About The Position**
 As a Manager within the Financial Crime Compliance Delivery Team, you will be responsible for leading a team of analysts by providing the coaching and oversight needed to ensure all projects meet organizational and client objectives. You will serve as a coach and mentor to ensure successful outcomes of engagements. In this position, you will also have direct client contact while establishing cross\-functional communication across multiple internal business units.
   

  

 You are a subject matter expert in KYC and AML domain. Your areas of focus will be to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements related to KYC, AML, and CTF, develop, implement, and maintain effective KYC, and AML policies and procedures and conduct regular reviews and audits of KYC processes and records to identify areas of improvement and ensure compliance.
   

  

 We are seeking individuals with a high level of client orientation and customer focus, experience in consulting, a dynamic fast\-paced environment with strong Financial Crime Compliance subject matter expertise and the ability to coach, mentor and lead.
   

  

**Primary Responsibilities**
* Manage a team of 25\+ analysts
* Identify top talent among the team and coach and develop leaders into Senior Analyst II roles.
* Evaluate team members for purposes of hire, termination, advancement, promotion or other job change.
* Manage client projects
* Interact regularly with major clients to strengthen the partnership, report results, and identify new opportunities for services provided.
* Oversee the team's production and results, seeking opportunities for improved efficiency and streamlined processes and conduct quality control review as necessary.
* Provide production/service reporting to senior leadership and clients.
* Work directly with partnership team to develop subject matter expertise and expand advisory services and consulting opportunities with clients.
* Involvement in certain internal strategic initiatives across the Managed Services practice working closely with Sr. Managers and others


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s Degree with 10\+ years or more of Anti\-Money Laundering (AML), or KYC Management experience
* Management experience and proven decision\-making ability
* Ability to lead projects, develop timelines, coordinate project teams and implement action items during the life of a project.
* Ability to multi\-task, work independently and as part of a team, establishing cooperative and collaborative working relationships.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Professional Certification (CAMS)
* Experience in a consulting or managed service environment
* Master’s degree
* Strong entrepreneurial spirit, highly collaborative, able to express ideas readily, manage change fluidly, able to influence and identify opportunities.


 AML RightSource is committed to fostering a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.
   

  

**Recruitment Scam Alerts**
**We’re aware of an increase in recruitment scams where individuals falsely claim to represent AML RightSource. These scammers may ask for money or personal information by offering fake job opportunities through e\-mail, text message or social media. If you encounter suspicious messages, do not respond.**

title: Legal Manager
description:
**Job Purpose**




 We are seeking an experienced and commercially minded Manager – Legal with 5–8 years of relevant experience to manage and support the company’s legal and contractual requirements. The role will provide legal support across customer and vendor contracts, commercial transactions, telecom and technology\-related matters, legal risk management, notices, disputes, compliance, and corporate governance. The Manager – Legal will work closely with Sales, Business, Procurement, Finance, Operations, Technology, HR, and senior management to ensure that business transactions are legally sound, commercially practical, and appropriately risk\-managed.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities**




  





**Contract Management \& Commercial Legal** 



* Draft, review, negotiate, and finalize customer and vendor agreements.
* Review MSAs, service agreements, NDAs, SLAs, purchase agreements, work orders, amendments, and other commercial contracts.
* Support Sales and Business teams in reviewing customer\-specific contractual requirements.
* Identify contractual risks relating to liability, indemnity, termination, payment, SLA commitments, warranties, confidentiality, data protection, intellectual property, and dispute resolution.
* Maintain a structured repository and tracker for contracts, renewals, notices, and key contractual obligations.
* Support contract negotiations while balancing business requirements and legal risk.
* Telecom \& Technology Legal Support
* Provide legal support for telecom, connectivity, cloud, data center, managed services, voice, security, and technology\-related transactions.
* Review customer and partner agreements involving network infrastructure, data centers, cloud services, voice solutions, and managed services.



**Legal Risk Management** 



* Identify legal and contractual risks in business transactions and recommend practical mitigation measures.
* Develop standard clauses, templates, contract playbooks, and negotiation guidelines.
* Support management in evaluating legal exposure arising from commercial commitments, customer disputes, and vendor relationships.
* Ensure appropriate approvals are obtained for deviations from standard contractual positions.



**Notices, Disputes \& Litigation Coordination** 



* Review and respond to legal notices received from customers, vendors, employees, or other stakeholders.
* Coordinate with external lawyers and counsel on litigation, arbitration, recovery matters, and other disputes.
* Maintain a litigation and legal\-notice tracker.
* Support management with case summaries, risk assessment, documentation, and follow\-up actions.



**Compliance \& Governance** 



* Support legal and corporate compliance requirements applicable to the organization.
* Assist in maintaining statutory and regulatory documentation in coordination with relevant internal teams and advisors.
* Support corporate governance activities and documentation where required.
* Monitor relevant legal and regulatory developments and highlight material business implications to management.



**Internal Stakeholder Management** 



* Act as a legal business partner to Sales, Procurement, Finance, Operations, Technology, and other functions.
* Conduct awareness sessions for internal teams on key contractual and legal issues.
* Help business teams understand contractual obligations in clear, practical language.
* Support faster business closure by providing commercially workable legal solutions while protecting the company’s interests.



  





**Qualification \& Experience:**



* **Education:** 
 LL.B. / LL.M. from a recognized institution; membership with the relevant Bar Council is preferred where applicable.
* **Experience:** 
 5–8 years of relevant legal experience, preferably in a corporate legal department, law firm, telecom, IT/ITES, technology, cloud, infrastructure, or related industry; strong commercial contract drafting and negotiation experience is essential.
* **Certifications / Additional Qualification (if any):** 
 Additional qualification or experience in corporate/commercial law, telecom, technology, data protection, or infrastructure contracts will be an advantage.



  





**Required Skills \& Competencies:**




  




* **Technical / Legal Skills:** 
 Commercial contract drafting and negotiation; MSA, NDA, SLA, vendor and customer agreements; legal risk assessment; dispute and notice management; corporate and commercial law; telecom and technology contracts; compliance and governance.
* **Functional Skills:** 
 Contract lifecycle management, legal research, stakeholder management, external counsel coordination, legal documentation, risk mitigation, and development of legal templates and playbooks.
* **Behavioral Competencies:** 
 Commercial acumen, analytical thinking, negotiation, problem\-solving, proactive approach, strong communication and documentation skills, attention to detail, ownership, integrity, and ability to work effectively with cross\-functional teams.

title: Lead - IR & Compliance
description:
**About Business**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
**Adani Group** 
 : Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan\-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large scale infrastructure development in India with O \& M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.
   

  

**Data Centre** 
 : Adani Data Centre has rapidly transformed from a nascent initiative to a leading innovator in the data infrastructure ecosystem. In just a few years, we have established ourselves as a key player in the data centre landscape, offering state\-of\-the\-art solutions in areas such as colocation services, cloud integration, and data security. Our commitment to reliability, scalability, and technological excellence has positioned us as a trusted partner for businesses navigating the digital age with confidence.
   

  

**Job Purpose:** 
 Lead \- Compliance Manager is responsible for ensuring adherence to financial and accounting regulations within the data centers industry. The role demands a strong understanding of finance and accounting principles, complemented by extensive experience in compliance and leadership. The ideal candidate will manage compliance initiatives, drive operational excellence, and foster a culture of accountability and integrity within the organization.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Industrial Relations
   

  

* Develop and implement the Industrial Relations strategy across project and operational data center sites.
* Foster a positive employee and workforce relations environment to ensure uninterrupted business operations.
* Establish effective engagement mechanisms with workforce representatives, contract labor, and site leadership teams.
* Handle employee grievances, disciplinary matters, domestic inquiries, misconduct investigations, and corrective actions in accordance with applicable laws and company policies.
* Conduct proactive IR risk assessments and recommend mitigation measures to prevent disputes and work stoppages.
* Lead negotiations and resolution of workforce\-related issues while maintaining organizational interests and legal compliance.
* Provide guidance and training to site leadership teams on employee relations and disciplinary processes.


 Labor Law Compliance
   

  

* Ensure full compliance with all applicable labor laws and regulations across multiple project and operational sites.
* Drive compliance under:
+ Code on Wages
+ Code on Social Security
+ Industrial Relations Code
+ Occupational Safety, Health \& Working Conditions Code
+ Contract Labour regulations
+ Shops \& Establishment provisions
+ Building \& Other Construction Workers (BOCW) requirements
+ Applicable state\-specific labor laws

* Monitor statutory registrations, licenses, renewals, returns, notices, and records.
* Establish periodic compliance reviews and compliance dashboards for management reporting.
* Coordinate compliance audits and ensure closure of observations within defined timelines.


 Contract Labor Management
   

  

* Develop and implement governance mechanisms for contract labor engagement across sites.
* Ensure compliance by contractors with all labor and statutory requirements.
* Conduct contractor due diligence and periodic compliance assessments.
* Monitor wage payments, statutory remittances, attendance records, welfare provisions, and contractor documentation.
* Lead contractor compliance audits and recommend corrective actions where required.
* Drive digitization and automation of labor compliance monitoring systems.


 Legal \& Regulatory Liaison
   

  

* Interface with labor departments, inspectors, statutory authorities, and government agencies.
* Manage labor inspections, audits, notices, and regulatory submissions.
* Coordinate with internal and external legal teams on labor\-related cases and litigation matters.
* Represent the organization before labor authorities and relevant forums as required.


 Governance, Reporting \& Risk Management
   

  

* Develop and maintain comprehensive compliance MIS and dashboards.
* Track key IR and compliance metrics across all sites.
* Identify compliance gaps, emerging labor risks, and workforce\-related concerns.
* Support business leadership with insights and recommendations for effective workforce governance.
* Develop standard operating procedures (SOPs), compliance frameworks, and governance mechanisms.


 Stakeholder Management
   

  

* Partner with Project, Operations, EHS, Procurement, Security, and Administration teams for seamless workforce management.
* Build strong working relationships with contractors, consultants, labor authorities, and local administration.
* Support site mobilization activities for new data center projects from an IR and compliance perspective.


 ESG, Safety \& Sustainability Responsibilities
   

  

* Promote AdaniConneX's commitment to ethical labor practices, human rights, diversity, equity, and inclusion.
* Ensure compliance with company ESG commitments related to labor welfare, contractor management, and responsible business practices.
* Drive adherence to workplace safety regulations and labor welfare provisions.
* Support implementation of worker welfare programs, safety awareness initiatives, and employee engagement activities.
* Ensure all workforce management practices align with organizational sustainability and governance objectives.


 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
   

  

* Zero major statutory non\-compliance observations.
* 100% timely statutory filings, registrations, and renewals.
* Contractor labor compliance score across all sites.
* Closure of labor audit observations within prescribed timelines.
* Number of industrial disputes and successful resolution rate.
* Compliance audit score and governance effectiveness.
* Workforce grievance resolution turnaround time.
* Labor\-related litigation and regulatory exposure metrics.
* Contractor welfare and compliance adherence ratings.


**Qualifications**
 Education
   

  

* MBA / PGDM in Human Resources, Labour Welfare, Personnel Management, or Industrial Relations.
* Degree in Law (LLB) will be an added advantage.


**Experience**
* 15\-17 years of experience in Industrial Relations, Labor Compliance, Workforce Management, and Statutory Governance.
* Experience in infrastructure, construction, manufacturing, power, data center, telecom, EPC, or industrial projects preferred.
* Strong exposure to managing contract labor across multiple sites.
* Proven experience in dealing with labor authorities, compliance audits, and workforce dispute resolution.

title: Associate - Compliance and Ops Risk Test Lead
description:
**Job Description**
**Job summary:**
 As a Compliance and Operations Risk Test Lead, your deep understanding of risk management and control evaluation will be instrumental in identifying and mitigating risks, thereby enhancing compliance and operational risk management. Your expertise in test execution will be crucial in managing and conducting precise and accountable tests, ensuring alignment with the firm's highest risks. Your analytical thinking and problem\-solving skills will be crucial in breaking down complex business objectives into manageable tasks and activities. You will also be responsible for planning and organizing your own work, and potentially that of a team, while liaising and coordinating activities across various departments. Your role will be integral in ensuring a cohesive and efficient testing framework, contributing to the seamless delivery of quality outcomes.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Understand and evaluate the assigned function's control environment with proven experience in assessing the adequacy, effectiveness and design of controls to ensure alignment with SOX, other regulatory frameworks \& with the firm's risk priorities.
* Conduct comprehensive testing processes with precision and accountability to assess the control environment, identify gaps and prepare robust documentation including process documents, process flows, and overview documents that support testing conclusions.
* Collaborate with Process/Control Owner, cross functional teams on testing schedule, obtain walkthrough of the process, document process changes, evidence gathering, analysis of potential issues and facilitate timely reporting.
* Drive issue validation, action plan quality and closure discipline by partnering with control owners to ensure remediation aligns with risk acceptance and compliance expectations.
* Lead stakeholder engagement by facilitating meetings with business owners and stakeholders at various management levels, fostering collaboration across engagements with minimal oversight, and effectively influencing stakeholders during challenging discussions.
* Read and interpret policies/standards/procedures to ensure accurate implementation of compliance requirements while continuously improving control evaluation methodologies and interpreting control ratings \& metrics to strengthen the firm's compliance and operational risk management framework.
* Serves as the primary point of contact for testers, providing guidance, resolving issues, and facilitating smooth communication within the team to ensure successful completion of testing engagements.


**Required Qualifications, Capabilities And Skills**
* Bachelor's degree in business, finance, or related field; or equivalent work experience. Minimum of 8 years of work experience in controls testing, audit, operational risk management and managing testing processes within a risk \& control environment.
* Demonstrated proficiency in advanced analytical thinking and problem solving skills with a track record of systematically organizing, comparing, and evaluating various aspects of a situation to identify key information.
* Proven ability to build strong partnerships with key stakeholders and collaborate with business \& functional experts to provide guidance and to recognize risks and gaps.
* Excellent organizational and time management skills \- ability to remain flexible and productive through shifting priorities and deadlines.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with an ability to influence business leaders in a meaningful and actionable manner.
* Demonstrated expertise in MS Office applications, with advanced skills in Excel, Word, and PowerPoint highly recommended.


**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities And Skills**
* Professional qualifications like CA, CPA, MBA Finance, CIA is preferred.
* Audit \& control testing background / experience.
* Comfortable using Intelligent solutions like Alteryx, Tableau to support testing activities or metrics reporting.
* Ability to innovate, challenge the status quo and identify automation opportunities.


**About Us**
 JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.
   

  

 We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Our professionals in our Corporate Functions cover a diverse range of areas from finance and risk to human resources and marketing. Our corporate teams are an essential part of our company, ensuring that we're setting our businesses, clients, customers and employees up for success.
   

  

 Control Management maintains a strong and consistent control environment through a joint accountability model that aligns managers with each function and region to mitigate operational risk. The team focuses on four areas: Control Design \& Expertise, Risks \& Controls Identification/Assessment, Issues \& Control Deficiencies and Control Governance \& Reporting.
